changelog: Adds two explicit random scheduling modes: source-block shuffle preserves the configured episode run length per source, while weighted random selection can prefer the same source for a configurable probability. The schedule preview and legacy editor expose the same choices, including the probability setting.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
